m: परि-जा f. (√ जन्) place of origin, source, AV.
परि-जात (परि-), mfn. begotten by, descended from (abl.), ib.
fully developed (अ-परिज्˚), ĀśvGṛ.
परि-जातक n. N. of wk. on domestic rites.
परि-√ 1. जॄ P. Ā. -जीर्यति, ˚ते, to become worn out or old or withered; to be digested, Suśr.
परि-जीर्ण mfn. worn out, old, withered, faded, decayed, MBh.
परि-जीर्यत् mfn. becoming old, MBh.
परि-√ ज्ञा P. Ā. -जानाति, ˚नीते (inf. -ज्ञातुम् ind.p. -ज्ञाय), to notice, observe, perceive, learn, understand, comprehend, ascertain, know or recognise as (2 acc.), RV.; &c.
परि-ज्ञा f. knowledge, L.
a: परिज्ञा — {c9c} U. 1 To be aware of; know, be acquainted with; वृषभोयमिति परिज्ञाय Pt. 1; Ms. 8. 126. --2 To find out, ascertain; सम्यक् परिज्ञाय Pt. 1. --3 To recognise; तपस्विभिः कैश्चित्परिज्ञातोऽस्मि Ś. 2. --4 To observe, perceive.
परिज्ञा, परिज्ञानं — 1 Thorough knowledge, complete acquaintance. --2 Recognition.

v: na॰ pari + jYA lyuw । sUkzpajYAne sU॰ si॰ 9 । 1 raNganATaH ।
m: परि-ज्ञान n. perception, thorough knowledge, ascertainment, experience, discrimination, MBh.; Hariv.; R. &c.
परि-ज्ञान—मय mf(ई)n. consisting in knowledge, BhP.
परि-ज्ञा˚निन् mfn. having much kn˚, wise, Kathās.
परि-ज्ञात mfn. thoroughly known, recognised, ascertained, learned, MBh.; Kāv. &c.
परि-ज्ञातृ mfn. one who knows or perceives, an observer, knower, Bhag.
wise, intelligent, W.
परि-ज्ञप्ति f. (fr. Caus.) recognition or conversation, Kathās. xxi, 128.
परि-ज्ञेय mfn. to be recognised or ascertained, comprehensible, MBh.; Var. &c.
a: परिज्ञेय — a. 1 To be recognised or ascertained. --2 Comprehensible, conceivable.

m: परि-जग्ध m. (√ जक्ष्) a proper name, Pāṇ. vi, 2, 146, Sch.
परि-√ जल्प् P. -जल्पति, to chatter, talk about, speak of (acc.), MBh.; Hariv.

s: klI, (pari + jalpa + BAve ktaH .) daSANgacitrajalpAntargatadvitIyajalpanam । yaTA, “praBornirddayatASAWyacApalAdyupapAdanAt । svavicakzaRatAvyaktirBaNgyAsyAt parijalpitam ॥” ityujjvalanIlamaRiH ॥
v: na॰ “praBornirdayatASAWyacApalAdyupapAdanAt । svavicakzaRatAvyaktirBaNgya syAt parijalpitam” ujjvalamaRyukte kaTanaBede ।
m: परि-˚जल्पित n. the covert reproaches of a mistress neglected by her lover, W.
a: परिजल्पितं — A covert indication (as by a servant) of one's own skill, superiority &c. by pointing out the cruelty, deceitfulness and such other faults of his master; Ujjvalamaṇi thus defines it: --प्रभोर्निर्दयताशाठ्यचापलाघुपपादनात् . स्वविचणताव्यक्तिर्भंग्या स्यात्परिजल्पितम् .. (Wilson renders the word by ‘the covert reproaches of a mistress neglected or ill-used by her lover’).

s: puM, (parigato janaH .) parivAraH । pozyavargaH । yaTA, mahimnaH stotre । “yadfdDiM sUtrAnno varada paramoccErapi satImaDaScakre vARaH parijanaviDeyatriBuvanaH ॥” niyatasanniDivarttiparicArakaH । yaTA, AnandalaharyyAm । 30 । “kirIwaM vEriYcaM parihara puraH kEwaBaBidaH kaWore kowIre sKalasi jahi jamBArimukuwam । praRamrezvetezu prasaBamaBiyAtasya BavanaM harasyAByutTAne tava parijanoktirvijayate ॥” “parijanaH niyatasanniDivarttiparicArakaH .” ityasyaSlokasya vyAKyAyAMgopIramaRatarkapaYcAnanaH ॥
v: pu॰ parigato janaH । 1 parivAre 2 pratipAlye jane amaraH ।
m: परि-जन m. (ifc. f(आ). ) a surrounding company of people, entourage, attendants, servants, followers, suite, train, retinue (esp. of females), MBh.; Kāv. &c.
a single servant, Kālid.; Kathās.; Pañc.
a: परिजनः — 1 Attendants, followers, servants taken collectively; परिजनो राजानमभितः स्थितः M. 1. --2 Especially, the retinue, suite, or train of females, the maids of a lady; R. 19. 23. --3 A single servant.

m: परि-जन—ता f. the condition of a servant, service, Kir. x, 9.
परि-जन्मन् m. the moon, L.
fire, L. (cf. परि-ज्मन्).
परि-जपित mfn. (√ जप्) muttered, whispered, prayed over in a low voice, Gobh.
परि-˚जप्त mfn. id., Var.
enchanted, Divyāv.
परि-जर्भुराण mfn. (fr. Intens. of √ भुर्) quivering, flickering, RV. i, 140, 10.

v: tri॰ pari + ji--SakyArTe vat ni॰ yAntAdeSaH । parito jetuMSakye ।
m: परि-जय्य See परि-जि.
परि-जय्य mfn. to be conquered or mastered, Pāṇ. v, 1, 93.
परि-जेतृ m. a victor, conqueror, L.
परि-√ जृम्भ् Ā. -जृम्भते, to spread all around, Prasannar.
परि-√ जि P. -जयति (inf. -जेतुम्), to conquer, overpower, MBh.
परि-जिहीर्षा f. (√ हृ Desid.) desire of avoiding or removing, Kād.
परि-जिहीर्षित mfn. kept away, avoided, shunned, Gobh.
परि-जिहीर्षु mfn. wishing to avoid, L.

s: [n] puM, (parijAyate iti । pari + jan + man । nipAtanAt sADuH .) candraH । agniH । iti sidDAntakOmudyAmuRAdivfttiH ॥ (paryyajatIti । ajeH paripUrvvasya SvannukzannityAdinA manpratyayo'kAralopaH AdyudAttatvaYca nipAtyate । parigantA । iti vedaBAzyam ॥)

m: परि-ज्मन् mfn. (√ गम्) running or walking or driving round, surrounding, being everywhere, omnipresent (said of the sun, of the clouds, of sev. gods &c.), RV.; AV. (as loc. or ind. all around, everywhere, RV.)
परि-ज्मन् m. the moon, L.
fire, L. (cf. परि-जन्मन्).
a: परिज्मन् — a. Ved. Running or walking round. --m. 1 The moon. --2 Fire.

v: tri॰ pari + jf--ki । paritogantari f॰ 1 । 64 । 5 BA॰
m: परि-ज्रि mfn. (√ ज्रि) running round, spreading everywhere, RV.

s: [n] puM, (pari + ju sOtraDAtuH + “Svannukzan pUzanniti .” uRAM । 1 । 158 । iti kanin । idantu ujjvaladattamatam .) indraH । agniH । iti saMkziptasAroRAdivfttiH ॥

m: परि-√ ज्वल् P. -ज्वलति, to burn brightly, blaze, glare, Kir.

v: pu॰ pari + ju--sOtraDAtuH kamin । 1 candre 2 agnO ca ujjvaladattaH । atra parijavan iti parijanman iti SabdadvayakalpanaM prAmAdikaM “SvannukzannityAdike uRAdisUtre parijvan ityasyEva pAWAt ।
m: परि-ज्वन् m. (Uṇ. i, 158) the moon, L.
fire, L. (cf. परि-ज्मन्)
a servant, L.
a sacrificer, L.
Indra, W.
a: परिज्वन् — m. 1 The moon. --2 Fire. --3 A servant.

m: परि-ज्यानि See अ-प्˚.
